notes.title: The Outpost Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Lovely Alchemists! [/h1]

I'm very happy to finally release the Outpost Update!
This update's primary aim was to rework outposts; side areas in the game that contain NPC's, trading, and the bounty board. 

This update not only improves their existing UI and functionality, but also adds a new card game to outposts, as well as two brand new outposts, each with their own NPCs. 

In addition to this, fast travel has been introduced allowing for more convenient world exploration. To unlock fast travel, you'll need to reach the second outpost and talk to an NPC within it.

There's plenty more, so let's break it down:

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a new card game to the outposts that is played with your party members.
[*] Added 2 new outposts, each with 3 new NPC stories.
[*] Added 4 new quests that are unlocked via NPC's in outposts
[*] Added Fast Travel (unlocked in the Whitewood Outpost)
[*] Added small markers to show where hostiles in active bounties can be found
[*] Added new "Trials of Old" achievement
[*] Restructured the UI of outposts.
[*] Fixed bug where the timeline had hostiles in the wrong order.
[*] Fixed bug in the quest preparation where dragging potions could appear to be behind the backpack slots.
[/list]

We really hope you enjoy the new quests, characters, and outposts!
Please let us know what you think!

Wishing you all the best,
Gilded Rune Games ❤️

notes.title: Take Me to the Potions Patch! (v1.0.4)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Lovely Alchemists![/h1]

Today's small patch fixes a few bugs and adds a useful QoL feature!

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2] 

[list]
[*] You can now go to the potion making scene from the quest scene directly via the pause menu without having to go to the map scene first!
[*] Increased the odds of dragon corn dropping from the ghost serpent in act 3
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped the potions on the second page of the potion shelf displaying correctly once you had filled it up.
[*] Fixed the Quality Sort button on the potion shelf
[*] Fixed a bug near the start of act 1 where the player character would get very close to Alania
[*] Made certain dark coloured texts in the story lighter when using an outline
[*] Changing the text outline setting now changes the text immediately (instead of after scene reload) in all scenes
[/list]

Happy brewing!

[i]Gilded Rune Games[/i]

notes.title: Another small day 1 patch! (v1.0.2)
notes.notes:
A small patch indeed but critical for those playing on easier difficulty levels.

[h1]Heres what changed![/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused potions quantities to be zero when crafting a potion with easier potion crafting difficulties.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused additional potion modifiers added via custom difficulty settings to replace instead of add to pre-existing potion modifiers.
[*] Fixed a graphical bug that caused the potion number not to update when crafting potions on a shelf different to the shelf you where viewing.  
[/list]

Again big thanks to everyone reporting bugs! 
Please do reach out if you find them :)

notes.title: It's time for the first patch! (v1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has reported to us via our [url=https://discord.gg/WyTMhHTcrs]Discord[/url], and via the Steam Discussions section.

[h1]Lets check out the fixes![/h1]

[list]
[*] Added option to disable combat screenshake.
[*] When using the story text outline, the text "legendary swordsman hero" is now a light blue instead of a dark blue making it easier to read.
[*] When playing on Steamdeck and creating your character, the steam keyboard appears when entering your name.
[*] Fixed spelling mistake in settings Menu: "Miscellanious" -> "Miscellaneous"
[*] Fixed spelling mistake in act 2 story: "Why are some many demons [...]" -> "Why are so many demons [...]"
[*] Fixed bug in act 2 where Heta would occasionally be facing the wrong direction
[/list]

Thank you all so much for playing our game!
If you have suggestions or know of more issues please reach out to us :)
